map.name: Skyline Courier

pointMassCheck.limitations: No bike size, suspension, wheel collision, motor or air control.

physics.catchDesign: Velocity-envelope catch, Bezier compression, full flat recovery

design.intent: Teach the high bridge route, then use an optional crest barrel for a short aerial delivery onto a readable catch.
design.signature: A barrel-assisted skybridge pop is the centerpiece; the ground route remains continuous below it.

sequence.purpose: Clear runway; show the first lesson before commitment.
Introduce climbing onto and leaving a broad roof-like plateau.
Teach the high reward line over an unobstructed ground fallback.
Return to ground level and normalize speed before the barrel.
Use the crest barrel for an optional forward-up pop, descending onto the bridge return.
Leave room after barrel landing for a zero-speed restart.
Carry the learned landing pitch into a lower road.
Finish on a wide, rollable deck with no further impulse objects.
Empty finish release after the last challenge.
